Two projects funded by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) started in May 2025 and run until April 2028:

- **PARAM-VC — Promoting Agricultural Resilience with AI-based Modeling and Value Chain Analysis** (BMBF + DST). MSM coordinates the project; Dr. Amit Kumar Srivastava is coordinator and principal investigator.
- **[AGRECO4CAST](https://www.agroecologypartnership.eu/agreco4cast) — Supporting Agroecological Transitions of Agroforestry Landscapes using an Innovative Transdisciplinary Assessment Framework.** Dr. Amit Kumar Srivastava is a principal investigator.
